history.note: RNR HEAD DISTRIBUTION (right-node raising over lexicalized compounds), default-on, parser-only NO reseed. Shared-head coordinated modifiers ('colon, gastric, endometrial and ovarian cancers') were UNREACHABLE to the lexicalized compound concepts: a multiword lexeme needs ADJACENCY, and the head sits once at the end, so cat_mod/Or (M3) unioned the right MODIFIERS but built a generic cancer with a disjunctive property, throwing away the concrete kinds (colon cancer n14247239, gastric C0024623, endometrial n14247458, ovarian C1140680). FIX (docs/notes/d63-rnr-head-distribution.md): `Parser::distribute_head` (SEED-time -- the grammar/chart carry no lexicon by design) splits the coordination on connectives, looks up each 'conjunct + head' IN ISOLATION (the isolated surface resolves the lexeme cleanly where the shared-head coordination cannot -- adjacency), builds each bare-kind NP typed by the HEAD class H with sem kind_of(Kᵢ), folds coordinate_np into a cat_group the distributive rules (subject and object) predicate over. SEMANTICS = group-of-kinds (B): core:is_a is a resource-model Property, NOT an Entity->Class->Prop axiom, so the union-restrictor Σx:H.Or(is_a(x,Kᵢ)) has no predicate the felicity gate can check; (B) references whole kinds directly (no is_a) and reuses the distributive machinery. (A)/(B) are NOT exclusive -- two encodings of one meaning; (A)'s supposed edge (uniform cat_kind predication) turns out not to be needed -- (B)'s distribution handles BOTH subject and object position (verified), and (A) still needs is_a. WALLS resolved in build: (1) group wouldn't combine -- common_super(Kᵢ)=Entity (UMLS CUIs lack a loaded ancestor narrower than the top) fit no concrete slot -> type the group by the HEAD class H (each Kᵢ ⊆ H); subject position was ALSO flagged (the pre-H-typing debug showed the VP slot as cat_kind) but that was a MISDIAGNOSIS -- after H-typing the group distributes in BOTH object and subject position (verified: 'Insertion or deletion mutations are common' / 'Colon, gastric and endometrial cancers are common' -> clean 1-reading union), no group->kind shift needed. (2) coverage gap (unit 53 -> 0 readings) -- the sense CROSS-PRODUCT (4 conjuncts x ~4 senses = up to 4^4 = 192 group seeds) exploded the forest -> take the TOP-ranked sense per conjunct (the union is ONE structural reading; sense choice is the cap/reranker's job). SUPPRESSION (M-RNR-3): a seeded cat_group in the LEAVES is necessarily an RNR seed (compositional groups build later in the CKY), so multiword_spans counts it and its span is PROTECTED like a lexicalized multiword -- the coordination's cat_mod/composition is pruned WITH the multiword widen fallback -> coverage-safe by construction (replace, not add). WITNESSED: cancer coordination 30 readings/5 skeletons -> 1 (And over the 4 concepts); 'insertion or deletion mutations' -> Or(C1512796, C1511760), 2 sense-variants of one skeleton. MEASURED: deterministic cap-only 2321->2304 (-17), encoded 2->4 -- the CLEAN signal; reranked drift-free encoded 12 (band 12-13 across draws), total 1124->1126 (FLAT: the reranker already sense-collapses these units, so cap-only + skeleton-count is where the RNR win shows). grammar-gap 0; differential oracle holds; the all-lexicalized gate keeps RNR OFF non-compound coordinations ('MSI and MMR deficiency' does not fire). Guards: dcg::parse::seed::rnr_tests (split_coord_conjuncts unit tests, CI no-snapshot) + the differential oracle packed==unpacked (RNR seeds via the shared seed_leaves). DEFERRED: head morphology (sg/pl re-lookup); the HEAD-REPEATED coordination of lexicalized compounds ('Colon cancer, gastric cancer and endometrial cancer are common' -> 80 readings of junk) -- RNR does NOT fire (no shared head to distribute -- each conjunct is already a full 'X cancer') and coordinating the compound NPs directly reopens the head's junk senses (the §2 multiword-preference-through-coordination problem); NOT on the WRN page (which uses the shared-head form). CORRECTIONS: (a) the design note's 'ovarian cancer does not lexicalize' was wrong, the plural surface DOES (C1140680); (b) subject position was NOT deferred (misdiagnosis, see above).

M3 CAT_MOD COORDINATED-MODIFIER CATEGORY (driver 1b, the coordination-`And` site (1a) deferred), parser-only, NO reseed. ROOT CAUSE (D63 §6, witnessed): coordinated ATTRIBUTIVE modifiers folded logical `And` (intersective) -- refine_attrib lifted a coordinated `S[adj]\NP` into the noun slot, so 'gastric, endometrial and ovarian cancers' parsed as a cancer that is gastric AND endometrial AND ovarian (an empty kind) when the grammar means UNION (gastric OR endometrial OR ovarian). The pivot is GRAMMATICAL not semantic: attributive comma-coordination is union; the intersective `And` is correct only PREDICATIVELY ('X is gastric and ovarian') and for bare stacking -- witnessed by tracing both ('Ovarian cancers are common and frequent' -> And, CORRECT; the attributive -> And, WRONG). FIX: a new nullary `cat_mod` category (restrictor sem, Rust-only ctor -- categories are name-keyed, so NO reseed) that adjectives LIFT into (combinators::mod_lifts, `KindRaised` excluded at the lift); constructions::coordinate_mod folds a comma/and/or list of cat_mod restrictors with `Or` REGARDLESS of surface connective (union over kinds); complete_coord grew a cat_mod branch; `mod_apply` is the SOLE attributive path. REMOVED refine_attrib + its `S[adj]\NP + cat_n` rule + Guard::NotProv -- a REPLACE, not an add: attributive coordination now routes ONLY through cat_mod/Or, and the unary-shift order (ModLift BEFORE CoordComplete) blocks the coordinate-then-lift `And` leak. WITNESSED: 'Gastric, endometrial and ovarian cancers are common' 8->4 readings, all Or (the intersective copies gone); 'MSI occurs in colon, gastric, endometrial and ovarian cancers' 82->30 readings / 19->5 STRUCTURAL SKELETONS (raw trace, sense-independent). MEASURED: deterministic cap-only A/B (--no-llm, drift-free) 2347->2321 (-26, grammar-gap 0, encoded 2 held); reranked drift-free replay encoded 10->12, total_readings 1027->1124. CAVEAT on the reranked +97: it is a SENSE_CAP=2 interaction, NOT structural over-generation -- every SENSE-INDEPENDENT measure is down or flat (cap-only -26; raw traces 82->30 on coordinated units, FLAT on single-adjective units: 'DNA repair processes' 12=12, 'Defects in DNA mismatch repair' 27=27). The baseline 1027 and this 1124 are replays of DIFFERENT ranks.json draws, so the delta conflates grammar + sense-draw; the clean grammar signal is the cap-only -26 and the skeleton-count 19->5. Guards: dcg::rules::combinators::dispatch_tests (76, incl. attrib_adjective_lifts_to_cat_mod_then_refines_a_plain_noun asserting `S[adj]\NP` no longer refines directly) + the differential oracle packed==unpacked (54). DEFERRED (M2, attempted + REVERTED): noun/named-entity modifiers joining the union -- extending coordinate_mod to accept cat_n/cat_np conjuncts (inline restrictor, no global lift, kind_compound nesting kept) made `colon` join the union but EXPLODED the mixed unit 30->64 readings / 5->32 skeletons, because a noun gains a coordinate mode ON TOP of its kind_compound (stacking) + cat_np-group modes (the same additive-ambiguity trap M3 avoided by REMOVING refine_attrib). Proper fix is coordinate-ONLY comma-lists (suppress stacking/NP modes inside a comma/and/or list), a distinct structural change; the attempt is saved as scratch m2-attempt.patch.

(1a) CANONICAL MODIFIER-`And` NORMAL FORM + a drift-calibration correction to the multiword-fix baseline. Parser-only, NO reseed. Found via a new skeleton view (EIGENIUS_TRACE_SKELETONS on trace_one_sentence: erase senses -> count distinct STRUCTURAL bracketings). ROOT CAUSE (traced): the noun refine machinery (refine_conjoin / refine_attrib) built the flat-Σ restrictor `And(existing, new)` in CKY DERIVATION ORDER, so the two attachment orders of one modifier set -- `And(compound, prep_of)` vs `And(prep_of, compound)` -- emitted commutatively-distinct terms that subsume_duplicates (β-equal only) never merged. WITNESSED on 'Many cancers exhibit an impairment of a DNA repair pathway': 196 readings / 40 structural skeletons, 6 of which were pure commutative duplicates of another 6 (the PP `of a DNA repair pathway` attaches to `impairment` in ALL of them -- `of` is nominal, so there is NO verb-attachment; this unit is NOT the 'PP-attachment' the older note called it). FIX: `conjoin_canonical` flattens the associative And-tree, SORTS conjuncts by a deterministic key (pretty_term), rebuilds left-nested -> both derivations emit the byte-identical Σ, so they pack + subsume. Also unified the refinement bound var (refine_attrib `__refine_x` -> COMPOUND_X) so the canonicalization is alpha-stable across an adjective/compound mix. WITNESSED collapse: PP unit 196->170 readings / 40->34 skeletons (exactly the 6 dups); the coordination unit was UNCHANGED (its And is fold_conn, already left-canonical -- that is driver 1b, a SEPARATE deferred site). MEASURED: deterministic cap-only 2407->2347 (-60, 5 units down, ZERO per-unit regression); reranked isolated drift-free by REPLAYING one ranks.json across baseline-vs-1a code: total 1079->1027 (-4.8%), encoded 10->10 UNCHANGED (structural-duplicate removal cannot reduce encoded). Guards: dcg::rules::combinators::dispatch_tests::conjoin_canonical_is_order_independent (CI, no snapshot) + the differential oracle. DRIFT-CALIBRATION CORRECTION: history[1] set expected.encoded=11 from one HIGH live draw; the replay shows the SAME code+rankings give 10, so expected.encoded is corrected to the drift-free floor 10 (eval-parse-rate.sh gates on the exact expected.encoded, so it must be the floor, never a peak draw -- that mismatch, not a regression, is what tripped RC=2). REMAINING lever (1b, scoped + deferred, NOT a canonicalization): coordination-`And` -- genuine distribution-vs-single-NP scope + a coordinated-pre-nominal-modifier attachment defect (duplicated restrictions `And(a,a)`) + a skeleton-eraser cross-lexicon-sense artifact (n/C prefix counted as structure).

RE-BASELINE. Multiword span-integrity STRUCTURAL fix, parser-only (NO reseed). Two commits: eb0c5ab (overlap boundary-exception) + 66d84de (widen-ladder), enabled by the forest-derivation tracer b578390 (EIGENIUS_TRACE_FOREST). ROOT CAUSE (traced): the base-cap multiword-preference cut was a per-split-position veto (protected_split) that could not express OVERLAPPING multiwords. Two lexicalized multiwords sharing a token -- 'cancer cell'[0,1] cap 'cell lines'[1,2]; 'aDNA'(C0000702)[0,1] cap 'DNA repair pathway'(C1511689)[1,3] -- are mutually exclusive per derivation, so protecting each one's interior GLOBALLY vetoed the split the OTHER needed (the determiner boundary / the alternative bracketing) -> the sentence GAPPED at base cap and exploded on widen. That is the x88 'a DNA repair pathway' failure the stashed widen-ladder workaround had (88->227): its own stash message said 'the multiword doesn't compose alone' = this overlap gap. FIX (A, eb0c5ab): boundary-exception -- an interior split k is left OPEN where a DIFFERENT multiword abuts (starts at k+1 or ends at k); an ISOLATED multiword stays fully protected (its cross-span compound-pile pruning is where the value is). (A) ALONE is cap-only PAGE-NEUTRAL (2867->2865): on the WRN page almost every overlap sentence ALSO widens for a sense-cap reason (subject determiners a_subj/the_subj/many_subj rank below cap 2 -- witnessed: a_subj seeds only at cap>=4), and at widen integrity was OFF, so the overlap fix was moot there. FIX (widen-ladder, 66d84de): hold multiword-preference ON through the ENTIRE widen ladder, lifting only at the FINAL rung (cap>=SENSE_CAP_WIDEN_MAX=16 / beam>=CELL_BEAM_WIDEN_MAX=512) -- so a sentence that widens for sense-crowding keeps its compounds collapsed instead of re-exploding; coverage still falls back to the compositional splits at the last rung, grammar-gap 0. This is the half that REDUCES multiplicity; (A) is the half that makes it SAFE (without (A) it re-gaps overlaps through every rung -> the 88->227 explosion, which is why the widen-ladder was stashed as a workaround). NEITHER HALF MOVES THE PAGE ALONE. WITNESSED -- deterministic cap-only A/B (--no-llm, drift-free, isolates the code): 2867->2407 (-16%), grammar-gap 0, encoded 2 held, >100 bin 7->3; the isolated multiword 'insertion or deletion mutations' stays 16 (a rejected variant B, same-span-only suppression, blew it to 112). RERANKED (live, ONE sample, drifts ~5%): encoded 10->11, total_readings 1295->1126 (-13%), grammar-gap 0, >100 bin 1, eval-parse-rate.sh PASS. CAVEAT: the reranked delta is one sample and conflates code + temp-0 drift; the drift-free evidence is the -16% cap-only. PARTIALLY addresses the x88/x56 PP-attachment lever the A1/A2 note called untouched -- it collapses the ON-WIDEN explosion, but the BASE-CAP structural PP/coordination ambiguity remains (e.g. 'MSI occurs in colon, gastric, endometrial and ovarian cancers' rose 24->82 cap-only, but the reranker absorbs it -> NOT in the reranked >100 bin). Guards: dcg::chart::tests (5 boundary-exception unit tests, CI no-snapshot) + the differential oracle packed==unpacked (both drivers share multiword_protected_splits). REJECTED ALTERNATIVE (B): abolish the veto entirely, drop only the same-span compound rebuild -- gap-safe but too gentle, cap-only 2867->3002 (+4.7%, lost the isolated-multiword cross-span pruning); reverted.

The merge bundled a dcg module REORGANIZATION (lookup.rs -> parse/, parser.rs -> rules/combinators.rs, packed.rs -> chart/, category.rs split into rules/) with a code/data-consistency fix: conn_list, which the parser (category.rs LIST_CONN) had always CONSTRUCTED, was finally DECLARED on the lexicon:Conn inductive. RE-BASELINE. Definite-referential fix. Definite + demonstrative determiners denoted the existential CPS (obj_exists_sem / exists_sem) as a documented first-cut; under negation that spuriously bifurcated into wide-scope (not-exists) vs narrow-scope (exists-not) -- a REAL ambiguity for `a`/`an`, vacuous for a definite's unique referent. Fix: new axiom ontology:the (the iota / definite operator) + referential sems (subject V(the(A)); object TV(the(T), subj)); 12 definite/demonstrative entries repointed; `a`/`an`/`some` + cardinals KEEP the quantifier sems (their scope split is real). The category is unchanged (sem-only edit) so grammar-gap is unchanged by construction; both scope derivations now normalise to one term and felicity::subsume_duplicates collapses them. The bootstrap edit changed the lexicon-bootstrap content hash and invalidated the 07-15 chain -> reseed --umls-all + v3-align -> wordnet-umls-aligned-v3-2026-07-16 (2.8 GB). Witnessed: cap-only grammar-gap 0 + missing-lexeme 0, WRN negation sentence 4->2 (1 structural skeleton, residual is a cross-lexicon `activity` sense dup); reranked encoded 7, ambiguous 54, open 1, grammar-gap 0, runtime 279s. The single traced, drift-immune signal is the WRN sentence AMBIG x2 -> ENCODED (cap-only 4->2). CAVEAT: encoded 3 -> 7 is NOT a controlled delta -- it accumulates span-integrity + the bare-mass And fix + this fix ACROSS intervening snapshot reseeds; against the last live-captured reranked run on the OLD snapshot (6914d01, encoded 7) this fix recovers the -1 the bare-mass run showed (6 -> 7). Floor set at 6 (see gates.faithfulness). Regression guards: dcg::lexicon::referential_definite_tests (CI, no snapshot) + definite_negation_collapses_referential (snapshot-gated, crates/eigenius-wordnet/tests/db_backed_encoding.rs).

RE-BASELINE. Quantifier-determiner fix. `several`/`many`/`few`/`most`/`both` were MISSING from the determiner lexicon, so `several cancers` had no quantifier reading and fell back to `several`'s WordNet gradable-ADJECTIVE entry used prenominally (`gt(deg_a, std_a)` -- the spurious 'more-several-than-standard' modifier). Two-part fix: (1) added the 5 as plural existential determiners (closed-class.esl, modeled on `some` but pl; cardinality opaque first-cut); (2) an ALWAYS-ON cross-POS prune (parse/seed.rs) that drops the open-class ADJECTIVE reading (`is_adjective_cat`, the S[adj]\NP seed) of any surface carrying a closed-class DETERMINER reading (`cat_forall`). Part 1 alone would leave determiner AND adjective (still 2); part 2 alone would gap the sentence (no quantifier reading) -- both needed.
